Rina (Content): quick sync: we want a lightweight OSS launch post + 3 mini tutorials for Next, Flask, and Ruby. keep each <500 words and include one runnable snippet.
Omar (DevRel): ok — I'll do Next + demo repo. small video clip (60s) to show cloning and run. captions required.
Tess (Marketing): timeline: publish in 6 business days. need assets for social: 2 hero images and short copy variants.
Ivy (SEO): include keywords: 'Redwood API quickstart', 'hosted LLM inference'. set meta desc ~150 chars. add og:image.
Rina (Content): inbound handling: tutorial signups -> community nurture; refapp repo stars -> devrel notify. webinar regs -> sales if corporate email domain. Tess confirm?
Tess (Marketing): confirmed. add utm_campaign=oss_mini_launch. create a feedback form in the refapp README.
Omar (DevRel): can I get a staging key? @keys-bot please advise.
keys-bot: staging_key posted to #secrets-ops. access: marketing/devrel read-only.
Rina (Content): content format: one-paragraph intro, 3 numbered steps, code block, "Run it" section with curl + node snippet, and a short benchmark note.
Ivy (SEO): also canonical tag on repo README to avoid duplication.
Tess (Marketing): I'll schedule promo: day0 announce, day2 tutorial highlight, day4 refapp demo, day5 webinar reminder.
Rina (Content): owners: Next/Omar, Flask/Rina, Ruby/Tess. I'll draft the launch post and PR templates.
Omar (DevRel): :shipit: I'll push the demo repo and short vid by EOD day3.
Rina (Content): thanks — posting the Notion brief in channel shortly.
text_snippet: OSS launch + 3 mini tutorials. owners assigned, staging key available, SEO & social tasks assigned, inbound routing to community nurture.
